title: Implement peer health tracking and uptime scoring
description:
Track per-peer: last_seen timestamp updated on each successful exchange, articles_accepted/rejected counters incremented on IHAVE outcomes, consecutive_failures counter reset on success and incremented on timeout. Expose peer_score(peer_id) -> f64 (higher = healthier). Artifact: transit/src/peering/peer_registry.rs.

Acceptance: score function is deterministic given the same inputs; unit test: peer with 100% accept rate scores higher than peer with 50% rate; consecutive_failures capped at a max (no overflow)
